newsitem.title: UK: TREG sets 100 mln stg placing, offer.
newsitem.headline: TREG sets 100 mln stg placing, offer.

text.p: TR European Growth Trust Plc aims to raise up to 100 million pounds via a placing and open offer of conversion, or C shares, of which 41 million has already been placed, the trust said in a statement. "The directors and the manager expect economic growth in Continental Europe to accelerate in 1997 and both interest rates and inflation to remain low," TREG said.
The offer closes on December 12 and dealings will start commence on December 19.

In a statement which offered investors the opportunity to "benefit from rubber, leather and lace," TREG noted that it was the top performing investment trust within the Continental Europe category over one, three and five years.

"The investment policy of TREG has been to invest predominantly in smaller and medium sized companies which have been selected for their outstanding growth potential - companies such as Nokian Tyre, a niche manufacturer of winter and specialist tyres; Ekornes, a leading supplier of leather furniture; and Wolford, the Austrian luxury tights manufacturer," investment manager Stephen Peak said.
After the conversion of the C shares, TREG will make a one-for-seven bonus Issue of TREG warrants shareholders.
If over 50 million C shares are subscribed in the placing and offer, TREG will cut its management fee from 0.8 percent to 0.75% pa of total net assets.
TREG is managed by Henderson Financial Management Ltd, which manages 21 investment trusts and has 4.7 billion pounds under management.
